createModal.emailHelp: This email will be their username for logging in.
createModal.copyInstructionsText:
Welcome to Numa!

Your account has been created with the following email address: {{email}}

To set up your password and access the system, please:
1. Go to {{origin}}/create-password
2. Enter your email address: {{email}}
3. Follow the instructions to create your password

If you have any questions, please contact your administrator.
